validationAdvisories.message: UsdUVTexture prim </Model/Materials/material_001/Normal> (connected through validating prim </Model/Materials/material_001/Surface>) reads an 8 bit Normal Map, but has non-standard inputs:scale value of (0.7, 0.7, 2, 1). inputs:scale must be set to (2, 2, 2, 1) so as fulfill the requirements of the normals to be in tangent space of [(-1,-1,-1), (1,1,1)] as documented in the UsdPreviewSurface and UsdUVTexture docs.

motor.advisoryDisposition: Non-default XY normal strength matches the source GLB value of 0.35; texture resolution, native texture import, and close-up appearance reviewed. Not a claim of warning-free USD compliance.
